title: IUST_NLP at SemEval-2023 Task 10: Explainable Detecting Sexism with Transformers and Task-adaptive Pretraining

bias_targets.methodology: Training and evaluating transformer-based classification models (such as BERT, DeBERTa, and RoBERTa) with task-adaptive pretraining to perform binary and fine-grained multi-class categorization of sexist content from online platforms like Reddit and Gab.
